annotations.title: Get on-page content optimizer + AI grade

description: On-page recommendations and an AI content grade for one page, benchmarked against the pages currently ranking for its target keyword, built together — one AI-gateway call produces both the grade and the recommendations). CHARGES ONE AI-gateway operation against the organization's shared monthly ceiling — not a plan-quota dimension of its own. The page crawl (target + up to 5 competitors) and the SERP fetch are both free. `url` does not have to belong to the project's own domain or to a page a site audit has crawled — any http(s) URL is graded fresh. ALWAYS narrow on `state` first: `target_unreachable` means the target page itself could not be fetched — an ordinary outcome, never treat it as 'this page scored zero'. `analysed` carries the full report; check `coverage.serpUnavailable` and `competitorsCrawled` before trusting the competitor comparison. `grade` is an AI-generated qualitative read of the measured signals, NOT a calibrated industry score. Does NOT detect AI-written content — that is not built; no reliable free technique exists for it.

keyword.description: The keyword this page is meant to rank for.

languageCode.description: Language code. Defaults to the project's stored market, else 'en'.

locationCode.description: Numeric location code. Defaults to the project's stored market, else 2840 (United States).

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

url.description: The page to grade (any http(s) URL).

name: get_content_optimizer_report
